title: 易·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 金色多镜片头盔遮住面部，束起深发与绿金武者铠甲相映。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Master Yi is an adult Ionian swordsman with a distinctive golden multi-lens goggle helmet, a covered composed face, long tied dark hair, and green-gold martial armor. Preserve the cluster of small round eye lenses and his lean natural adult silhouette. Fully covering layered clothing, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots conceal the body, while his curved sword remains safely sheathed rather than raised or drawn.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: jade green, gold, lilac pencil shadow, pale mountain blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
